## Checklist

- [ ] For non-trivial changes, discussed in an issue first (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Commits are small and focused: `<module>: <imperative>` subject, body kept minimal.
- [ ] Compiles cleanly with `-Wall -Wextra` and `make` passes.
- [ ] Follows the K&R/Linux style (`make fmt` / `.clang-format`).
- [ ] Commits signed (`git commit -S`), if possible.
- [ ] No new runtime/build dependency and no non-trivial RSS / binary-size increase.
